name: You Su-young
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: A Korean grappler-wrestler (16-4, 2 NC; 2-1 UFC) who won Road to UFC Season 3 and grinds out decisions: his last six wins all went the distance. Coming off his first UFC loss, a second-round rear-naked choke against Elijah Smith in March after he won round one on the mat.

how_they_fight.Striking: Functional, mostly to set up level changes and clinches; calf kicks and knees in the clinch. Low output (about 2 significant strikes per minute) but hard to hit cleanly (68% striking defence in our numbers). When his takedowns fail he can be out-landed: Long Xiao out-struck him 68-58 and he still won 29-28 x3 on a cut.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Chain wrestler: 4 of 5 takedowns and over 10 minutes of control vs Shohei Nose, 8 of 14 vs Zhawupasi Daermisi, 5 of 10 vs A.J. Cunningham, 4 of 8 in round one vs Smith. Regionally a submission threat (five sub wins, including a fourth-round finish).
how_they_fight.Defense: Danger zone is the entry: Smith met his second-round rush with an uppercut and hook, dropped him and choked him out. Also stopped by Dastan Amangeldy at 4:57 of R3 in 2023. Stopped twice in 22 fights.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Grinds three hard rounds and is usually ahead early via wrestling; recent pattern is decisions, not finishes (finishes overall: R1 x6, R2 x1, R4 x1, none since 2023). Absorbed a late elbow storm from Xiao and survived. Both stoppage losses came after he had been controlling or competitive: R2 (Smith) and late R3 (Amangeldy).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Disciplined game-planner who takes rounds with control; weakness is shooting straight in on hitters when the takedown isn't set up.

patterns: Wins on the scorecards: last six wins all decisions
Takedowns dry up against good defenders (0 for 6 vs Xiao)
Vulnerable to counters on his entries (Smith R2 KD then RNC)
concerns: First career back-to-back losses if he drops this one
Low strike output if takedowns fail
keys_to_beat: Defend the first takedown and punish the entry with uppercuts/elbows
Keep it standing and outwork him on volume
Threaten from bottom; don't accept long control

news.text: Lost to Elijah Smith by rear-naked choke at 1:04 of round 2 after winning round one with chain takedowns; first UFC loss.
Faces UFC debutant Cody Chovancek at UFC Edmonton.
